name: CTID ATT&CK → Microsoft 365 Security Capabilities Mapping
owner: Center for Threat-Informed Defense (CTID) — MITRE Engenuity
description: Mapping of MITRE ATT&CK 14.1 Enterprise techniques to Microsoft 365 security service capabilities. Unusually granular per-capability files (Defender for Endpoint, Identity Protection, etc.) that enable licensing-tier (E3 vs E5) coverage analysis. Snapshot 2023-12-11.
relationToCloudSecurity: Canonical reference for M365 platform threat-informed defense; commonly cited in CASB/SSE evaluations.

lifecycle.notes: Snapshot. Largest CTID mapping set due to per-capability granularity.

current_extraction.notes: Reference-only. Upstream publishes this mapping at mappings/m365/attack-14.1/m365-12.11.2023/ and retains prior versions (attack-14.1, attack-16.1). Fetch from upstream rather than relying on a copy here.

extraction_history.reason: Removed the committed mapping and reverted to reference-only, matching this document's already-declared desired_end_state. The snapshot mapped ATT&CK 14.1 against a current 19.2, and upstream retains every version we held (attack-14.1, attack-16.1) plus newer ones. Also removed 35 per-capability split files that split-file.py generates from the consolidated mapping; the script is retained and reproduces them in one run, so the outputs were regenerable rather than irreplaceable. Files remain in git history and S3.

desired_end_state.notes: CTID mappings are Apache-2.0 and published upstream with prior versions retained (attack-14.1, attack-16.1), so a copy here drifts without adding anything. Stub points upstream.
